scripts.text:
[Halgus]
Have you gotten rid of the Pupa?
scripts.translation:
[哈尔古斯]
你处理掉虫蛹了吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放弃

scripts.text:
[Halgus]
Hmm, I don't think you've gotten rid of 50 Pupa yet...
scripts.translation:
[哈尔古斯]
嗯，我觉得你还没有处理掉50只虫蛹...

scripts.text:
[Halgus]
Remember, get rid of 50 of those Pupa from the field.
scripts.translation:
[哈尔古斯]
记住，去野外处理掉50只虫蛹。

scripts.text:
[Halgus]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[哈尔古斯]
你确定要停止狩猎吗？
你目前的进度将会被清除。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Halgus]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[哈尔古斯]
好吧，如果你改变主意了，随时回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Halgus]
Remember, get rid of 50 of those Pupa from the field.
scripts.translation:
[哈尔古斯]
记住，去野外处理掉50只虫蛹。

scripts.text:
[Halgus]
Oh thank you so much.
I know that I could've probably done this myself but it's not easy to be standing here all of the time.
scripts.translation:
[哈尔古斯]
哦，太感谢你了。
我知道我本来可能自己也能做到，但一直站在这里确实不容易。

scripts.text:
[Halgus]
New here are you?
Well look, I like helping new faces around here.
And lets be honest, you are not the prettiest looking face I've seen.
scripts.translation:
[哈尔古斯]
你是新来的吧？
嗯，我喜欢帮助这里的新面孔。
说实话，你也不是我见过的最好看的一张脸。

scripts.text:
[Halgus]
None-the-less my daughter thought it would be fun to gather pupa around this field and it's becoming unsightly.
Do you mind helping me get rid of some Pupa to clear out this field?
scripts.translation:
[哈尔古斯]
不过，我女儿觉得在这个田地里收集虫蛹很有趣，但这让这里变得很难看。
你介意帮我处理掉一些虫蛹，清理一下这片田地吗？

scripts.text: Sure, I don't mind
scripts.translation: 当然，我不介意

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Halgus]
Really? What would you like to do to help?
scripts.translation:
[哈尔古斯]
真的吗？你想怎么做来帮忙？

scripts.text: Gather Items
scripts.translation: 收集物品

scripts.text: Get rid of Pupa
scripts.translation: 处理虫蛹

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Halgus]
Can you collect ^00CE0025 Chrysalis^000000 and return them to me, I promise to reward you well.
scripts.translation:
[哈尔古斯]
你能收集^00CE002525个茧^000000并交给我吗？我保证会好好奖励你。

scripts.text: I have Chrysalis
scripts.translation: 我有茧

scripts.text: What did you need?
scripts.translation: 你需要什么？

scripts.text:
[Halgus]
Amazing you found so many that fast.
Like I promised, give me the Chrysalis and I will reward you with my wisdom.
scripts.translation:
[哈尔古斯]
真厉害，你这么快就找到了这么多。
就像我承诺的那样，把茧给我，我会用我的智慧来奖励你。

scripts.text:
[Halgus]
I need ^00CE0025 Chrysalis^000000 and no less please.
scripts.translation:
[哈尔古斯]
我需要^00CE002525个茧^000000，请一个都不要少。

scripts.text:
[Halgus]
I need ^00CE0025 Chrysalis^000000.

[Halgus]
Thank you so much!
How many would you like to get rid of?
scripts.translation:
[哈尔古斯]
非常感谢！
你想处理掉多少？

scripts.text: 50 Pupa
scripts.translation: 50个虫蛹

scripts.text: 100 Pupa
scripts.translation: 100个虫蛹

scripts.text: 150 Pupa
scripts.translation: 150个虫蛹

scripts.text:
[Halgus]
If you can get rid of 50 of those Pupa from the field I will be grateful.
scripts.translation:
[哈尔古斯]
如果你能帮我清除掉50个虫蛹，我将不胜感激。

scripts.text:
[Halgus]

scripts.text:
[Halgus]
If you change your mind, please come back.
scripts.translation:
[哈尔古斯]
如果你改变主意了，请随时回来。

scripts.text:
[Halgus]
If you change your mind, please come back.
scripts.translation:
[哈尔古斯]
如果你改变主意了，请随时回来。

scripts.text:
[Halgus]
You could probably easily help me out, but I want to give charity to those who are not as strong as you.
scripts.translation:
[哈尔古斯]
你大概能轻松帮我解决，但我想把这份慈善留给那些不如你强大的人。

scripts.text:
[Halgus]
Please return to me when you are a little stronger.
scripts.translation:
[哈尔古斯]
等你变得稍微强一点后，请再来找我。
